The '''Dorenia system''' was located in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument known as the [[Dorenian Beshniquel/Legends|Dorenian Beshniquel]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Doikk Na'ts}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Dorenian Beshniquel/Legends|Dorenian Beshniquel]]|system=Dorenia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dorenia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA" />
